articles.title: DGP flags off motorcycle rally from Ladakh to Gujarat to promote national unity
articles.summary: Ladakh Director General of Police (DGP) Anand Jain on Saturday flagged off a motorcycle rally from here to Gujarat in commemoration of Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, carrying the message of national unity and a drug-free India, police said.
